newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,099 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,099 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 1,099 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 34 wheat, 568 corn, 483 soybean, 9 soymeal and 5 soyoil futures contracts traded.
The overnight trend for corn was one to 1-1/2 cents per bushel lower, soybeans down 3 to 5-3/4 cents, wheat down 1/4 to 2-1/2 cents, soymeal down $0.90 a ton and soyoil down 0.08 cent a lb.
